hints.content: We have two tapes that are the same length. Let's start by writing an expression for the length of each tape.

The top tape has two parts, one with a length of $8$ units and the other with a length of $q$ units.

The total length of the top tape is $8+q$ units.

The bottom tape has a length of $12$ units.

So, the tape diagram shows us $8+q=12$.

The section labeled $q$ is $8$ units shorter than the $12$ unit long tape.

$q=12-8=?$
